scope: Setup only: in test_a_direct_hit_on_a_benchmark_endpoint_gets_the_engines_404, the Settings(...) call gains aigateway_base_url="http://aigateway.test" plus a WHY comment above it. No assertion, other test or helper in the file changes.
reason: Unnamed, the local App falls back to the loopback gateway 127.0.0.1:9105. When a developer's own gateway there lists a local model (ollama/...), the run behind /corpus builds its own world and logs the holdings-shelf line a second time, so the test fails on that laptop only and the pre-push hook blocks every Engine push from it. Naming the address the test's own url4.toml already uses keeps the test offline on every machine; the assertion it defends is unchanged.
